def:cycle-count-source

JP PDF p. 12 · EN PDF p. 16

JP main-only · printed p. 12 · EN main-only · printed p. 16

Lean Nat and HOL nat encode the same counter labels; both update functions are k+1. Phase and display values are arbitrary counter-indexed data, not assumed injective, monotone or periodic with respect to time. The state tuple retains the counter even if displays repeat. This is an input data interface, not a claim that infinitely many ticks have physically occurred or that counters alone supply seconds. The final source clause assigning frequency/period/Hz/seconds/intervals to the generated representation stage is recorded as a dependency and physical interpretation; these five algebraic roots do not assert existence of that later representation or of calibrated numerical values.

1 mapped components
  1. chapter2-roles/natural-counter-and-update

    Natural-number internal counter positions, successor updates, and phase/display data at the same counter position.

    Counter labels distinguish the input states even when display values repeat. The repeated-display control is retained. No equal-duration, frequency, period or Hz value follows from these counter definitions.

def:local-scene

JP PDF p. 13 · EN PDF p. 17

JP main-only · printed p. 13 · EN main-only · printed p. 17

Scene is a supplied physical-input domain; Local: Scene->Role->Type is instantiated by the source's scene- and role-indexed carriers. ObjectSpecData selects a common scene and a BindWitness in that scene. HOL uses the corresponding scene parameter and local-carrier predicates. Finite or locally bounded is retained exactly as the source alternative, not replaced by global finiteness, compactness or metric boundedness. The four membership criteria and exclusion of temporal tests are physical input requirements, not kernel conclusions from the abstract Scene type. The formal theorem concerns preservation of the supplied common scene/roles; it is not credited as proving physical locality or absence of hidden temporal dependence.

def:local-scene-components-g

JP PDF p. 13 · EN PDF p. 17

JP main-only · printed p. 13 · EN main-only · printed p. 17

Instantiate the generic Lean LC Sc R with the source subset subtype {x in Sc satisfying the R-specific specification}; Scene is the index of that input region, not the region's point carrier. Thus the generic Type-valued LC does not discard source membership. HOL local_carrier a Sc R is the corresponding guarded subset of an ambient component carrier. The arbitrary role-indexed tuple is the product of these four types before a BindWitness is required. BindWitness adds the next definition's four predicates and must not be used to assert that every arbitrary tuple already satisfies them. Empty component subsets and hence an empty product are allowed. No distinctness of physical carriers or physical components across different role positions is required.

Later ObjectSpecData additionally carries a tracked-object abstraction field; that later condition is not added to this local binding definition. These predicates retain their stated physical meanings as input obligations. No proof of physical realization or automatic nonemptiness is inferred from the typed construction.

Lean PairAt x u is the dependent product over Fin 2 of the actual arrival-image subtypes (0=Clock, 1=Detector). pairEncoding is its two-sided equivalence with the ambient dependent-function carrier satisfying each image-membership predicate, and nativeJoint extends the actual PairDatum.joint through this equivalence. HOL uses Boolean roles (False=Clock, True=Detector), disjoint sum injections and PiE UNIV (images u). The original configuration_comparison_seed is a generic ambient relation container: it alone does not impose this joint carrier bound before L1/L2. The exact_configuration_comparison_seed adds precisely the manuscript joint-relation carrier bound on admitted node pairs. The checked restriction_identity_iff proves that restriction preserves the entire relation exactly when this bound holds; it does not justify silently discarding arbitrary off-carrier edges. The existing generic factorization and later comparison theorems remain unchanged and apply to this restricted class. Neither L1, L2, factorization, component injectivity nor nonempty arrival images is assumed by the initial input definition. Values at nonadmitted node pairs remain outside the source family.

def:comparison-local-loop-specifications

JP PDF p. 33 · EN PDF p. 39

JP main-only · printed p. 33 · EN main-only · printed p. 39

This definition precedes L1/L2. The new Spec uses only the ordered admission relation, the actual arrival-image family, and a positive raw closed word; it assumes neither recovery uniqueness nor generated transport maps. The role and Jcmp are fixed external parameters and select any subset of this carrier. The base is kept as a dependent index and is recovered as the head of its displayed positions; m is the edge-list length. A list ps of subsequent positions and the list of signs reconstruct the indexed tuple through zip only when their lengths agree. Lean's intrinsic Raw path and HOL's path predicate impose the same closure and directional edge tests. HOL's larger ambient value type is restricted by domain subset carrier at the base. This correspondence establishes the raw input definition; the existing action-layer Spec may include zero-length words, so its later application must retain the positive-length restriction. No action-layer equivalence is inferred merely from this new definition contract. The later raw-to-native connection is explicitly proved in CoreLocalLoopBridge, with the same specified domain and positive length. Its L≤2 assumptions belong only to that later action construction.

def:L1

JP PDF p. 34 · EN PDF p. 40

JP main-only · printed p. 34 · EN main-only · printed p. 40

The role is an arbitrary parameter of the generic family, and the manuscript quantifies it over both comparison roles. Empty arrival domains are permitted. No injectivity on the entire ambient carrier is assumed. Complement roots describe the native active consequents. The manuscript first-failure region also requires its unchanged preceding-completion bundle; negation of a guarded consequent is used only there. The same-scope HOL encodings use explicit carrier sets for Lean subtypes and a C,D product for Fin 2 dependent pairs; points outside those sets are not witnesses. HOL total function extensions are fixed outside their actual domains in the existing factorization encoding, matching equality of the native partial functions rather than adding a physical premise. The local realized-map nonfixed theorem retains exactly its realizability premise in both systems. Source recovery, word admissibility, atom-kind restrictions, source irreducibility, saturation and graph actions are the existing native definitions. Neither rolewise injectivity nor transport realizability is imposed at the FC1 or FC2 failure stage. Native Data assumptions apply only after those stages have passed.

1 mapped components
  1. chapter4-input/l1-all-local-arrivals-injective

    L1 requires every arrival-image point to have a unique source preimage, for both comparison roles and every node. It is equivalent to injectivity of each arrival map on its own domain.

    The source carrier, image and role/node quantifiers are retained. Empty arrival domains satisfy this condition; arrival is not made total or surjective onto the entire reception fiber.

def:L3

JP PDF p. 55 · EN PDF p. 61

JP main-only · printed p. 55 · EN main-only · printed p. 61

CoreComparisonStage.L3 is the consequent Q at a typed input whose data already carries L1 and rolewise partial injections. It is not identified with the whole guarded manuscript condition. The full source formula remains P implies Q and its bundle P and (P implies Q); CoreRawComparisonEntry.guarded_step_iff provides the exact bridge. When P fails, the implication does not supply a realization or establish the bundle. Empty specification sets and empty specified domains remain allowed. HOL stage_L3 splits exactly the C and D quantifiers; its realizable predicate uses existential output membership on the actual graph. Complement roots describe the native active consequents. The manuscript first-failure region also requires its unchanged preceding-completion bundle; negation of a guarded consequent is used only there. The same-scope HOL encodings use explicit carrier sets for Lean subtypes and a C,D product for Fin 2 dependent pairs; points outside those sets are not witnesses. HOL total function extensions are fixed outside their actual domains in the existing factorization encoding, matching equality of the native partial functions rather than adding a physical premise. def:operative-predicate

JP PDF p. 62 · EN PDF p. 69

JP main-only · printed p. 62 · EN main-only · printed p. 69

The raw entry quantifies over realized configurations and typed comparison-rule data without assuming L1 or L2. Lean carries the specifications as a proof-indexed family over L1/L2; proof irrelevance makes the entered family independent of proof witnesses. Isabelle keeps the same raw configuration, restricts arrival domains to actual reception nodes, and interprets configuration_comparison only after obtaining L1/L2 from the full gate. Under an established prefix, each guarded condition reduces by guarded_step_iff to its active consequent. The full seventh-stage bundle is thus L1 and L2 together with the five residual conditions; guarded G remains an implication. Only the operative branch invokes the pre-existing output theorems. Native Output stores the varying realized loops, local projections and canonical relation; the input fixes the transport datum and specifications, while equivalence relations, quotient types and full projections are their canonical definitions. The eight-component gluing datum and three-component quotient are assembled from these fixed and generated components, not identified with the three Output fields alone. Empty carriers and failed L1/L2 cases are retained.

def:comparison-gluing-datum

JP PDF p. 63 · EN PDF p. 69

The raw entry quantifies over realized configurations and typed comparison-rule data without assuming L1 or L2. Lean carries the specifications as a proof-indexed family over L1/L2; proof irrelevance makes the entered family independent of proof witnesses. Isabelle keeps the same raw configuration, restricts arrival domains to actual reception nodes, and interprets configuration_comparison only after obtaining L1/L2 from the full gate. This is an input-interface definition. It adds neither a primitive time value nor a claim that all later representation-stage conditions already hold. Curried formal parameters are paired only by the proved evaluation identity; the concrete same-input assembly establishes preservation of the previously generated carriers. The surrounding paragraph on omitted uniquely recoverable indices is not part of this definition block. These scope-interface roots are attached to the adjacent input contract; their complete source prose receives a separate context record. Support is a supplied relation, not a mathematical proof of the physical existence of a carrier. The source-index set remains the manuscript nonempty input. The selector is not unique and is not assumed injective. Its HOL total extension is used only on the declared index set; Lean uses the corresponding subtype. The constant-carrier Boolean-source control establishes only nonidentification, not a physical implementation. The relation restriction is the exact intersection formula in both languages, and subtype erasure retains both endpoint membership conditions.

Proof-body and dependency correspondence
  • The theorem combines conditional stagewise generation, the local cocycle, and selected-coordinate factorization with local/global compatibility.

def:ordered-field-affine-coordinate-realization

JP PDF p. 80 · EN PDF p. 89

JP main-only · printed p. 80 · EN main-only · printed p. 89

CoreAffineRealization.Data retains the full additive action law omitted from the narrower CoreAffineFrequency calculation interface. The field is a type parameter with ordered-field instances; the representational carrier is arbitrary and no LinearOrder instance is assumed for it. Its chosen strict relation is constrained by strict_sign, from which strict linearity follows. The five realization components correspond to these field/carrier parameters, act, diff, and the selected embedding argument; coordinateDifference explicitly retains the canonical projection as well. HOL uses a possibly empty carrier P, closure of act, and guards on every point. Values outside P do not belong to the manuscript action. This checks the conditional realization, not existence of such a realization for every previously chosen codomain.

6 mapped components
  1. affine/action

    RepVal x QtyVal -> RepVal with zero and additive composition laws; action is free and transitive.

    Data.act with zero_action/add_action/diff_spec; HOL closed is the carrier encoding of the Lean result type. Source freeness/transitivity are adjacent prose and are proved by action_free/action_transitive.

    lean · CoreAffineRealization.lean · line 21
    isabelle · Core_Affine_Realization.thy · line 14

  2. affine/coordinate-difference

    Every x1,x0 in the canonical comparison quotient maps to the field displacement diff(Rep(x1),Rep(x0)).

    Rep = selected embedding after the global order-quotient projection. The source argument order x1,x0 is retained; injection applies to the selected order embedding, not the earlier projection.

    lean · CoreAffineRealization.lean · line 93
    isabelle · Core_Affine_Realization.thy · line 105

  3. affine/difference-specification

    For all a0,a1 in the carrier and every delta in the field, act(a0,delta)=a1 iff delta=diff(a1,a0).

    The ordered arguments are destination a1 then source a0. This characterizes the unique displacement rather than presupposing an ordinary subtraction on the affine carrier.

    lean · CoreAffineRealization.lean · line 21
    isabelle · Core_Affine_Realization.thy · line 14

  4. affine/quantity-field

    For each fixed comparison role R, QtyVal is a linearly ordered field with its field operations and order.

    Lean Field K, LinearOrder K, IsStrictOrderedRing K and HOL linordered_field preserve the quantitative field; no real-number specialization is imposed.

    lean · CoreAffineRealization.lean · line 21
    isabelle · Core_Affine_Realization.thy · line 14

  5. affine/realization-bundle

    The quantity field, representation carrier, action, displacement, and selected order embedding are retained together for the same role and source context.

    Data carries the affine fields. The selected order embedding and its prior comparison-to-order-quotient projection remain the separate projection/embedding parameters of coordinateDifference. The projection is not assumed injective.

    lean · CoreAffineRealization.lean · line 21
    isabelle · Core_Affine_Realization.thy · line 14

  6. affine/strict-sign

    For all a0,a1, a0<repr a1 iff 0<qty diff(a1,a0).

    The carrier strict relation is Data.lt. Linearity follows from the action and field structure via induced_strict_linear; it is not added as an unrelated carrier premise.

    lean · CoreAffineRealization.lean · line 21
    isabelle · Core_Affine_Realization.thy · line 14

Proof-body and dependency correspondence
  • The realization retains the ordered quantity field, affine carrier/action, uniquely specified displacement, strict-sign equivalence and selected representation embedding.
  • Data.diff_spec proves action_free and action_transitive; zero_action gives zero displacement, add_action gives the displacement cocycle, and strict_sign gives the induced strict linear order. coordinateDifference composes the prior projection and selected embedding before taking destination-minus-origin displacement.
  • HOL carrier closure is the explicit counterpart of Lean result typing. Neither backend replaces the quantity field by the reals or assumes the comparison projection injective.

def:frequency-representation

JP PDF p. 81 · EN PDF p. 89

JP main-only · printed p. 81 · EN main-only · printed p. 89

ArrivalData is instantiated with token_C, the actual C-arrival domain and evaluation, and the canonical comparison projection on its tagged image; the supplied Q is the existing canonical comparison quotient, not a newly postulated time coordinate. Lean RawWindow is the four-component product and Window adds exactly the admission witnesses. HOL uses explicit U,J,Q carriers and restricts its total functions to admitted raw windows; values outside them are not manuscript-defined quantities. The comparison representation need not be injective on comparison classes: only the subsequent order-quotient embedding is injective. No such extra injectivity premise is imposed here. The source-family result assumes nonempty, same-source, constant frequencies and periods exactly as written; it does not prove existence of an invariant family for every source. The source definition's natural count embedding is Nat.cast in the ordered field.

JP PDF p. 88 · EN PDF p. 97

Typed heterogeneous expressions use index/type/value tags; the universal manuscript expression parser is not asserted. Rule closure itself supplies no missing physical input.

2 mapped components
  1. chapter4-generation-dependency/least-rule-closed-superset

    Cl_Dep(In) is the intersection of all rule-closed supersets of In; GenDef means membership in this least closure.

    Rules have a set of premises and one conclusion. The family is nonempty because the whole expression type is closed. The predicate-family Lean bridge and set-intersection HOL definition have the same universal-membership condition.

Their component definitions remain explicit in the inventory. The mapped roots verify the condition expansion and mathematical constituent contracts; they do not count the number of displayed tuple entries as the number of mathematical objects.

thm:master

JP PDF p. 93 · EN PDF p. 103

JP main-only · printed p. 93 · EN main-only · printed p. 103

The raw entry quantifies over realized configurations and typed comparison-rule data without assuming L1 or L2. Lean carries the specifications as a proof-indexed family over L1/L2; proof irrelevance makes the entered family independent of proof witnesses. Isabelle keeps the same raw configuration, restricts arrival domains to actual reception nodes, and interprets configuration_comparison only after obtaining L1/L2 from the full gate. Under an established prefix, each guarded condition reduces by guarded_step_iff to its active consequent. The full seventh-stage bundle is thus L1 and L2 together with the five residual conditions; guarded G remains an implication. Only the operative branch invokes the pre-existing output theorems. Native Output stores the varying realized loops, local projections and canonical relation; the input fixes the transport datum and specifications, while equivalence relations, quotient types and full projections are their canonical definitions. The eight-component gluing datum and three-component quotient are assembled from these fixed and generated components, not identified with the three Output fields alone. Empty carriers and failed L1/L2 cases are retained.

Proof-body and dependency correspondence

  • The full raw-comparison master uses guarded entry plus the stage equivalence. The guard identity retains L1 and L2 while exposing the conditional residual stage, including source and mixed-loop duties.
  • Vacuity of a gluing predicate before valid entry cannot make the input operative. Both systems preserve the same raw-input domain and all local conditions.

thm:canonical-uniqueness

JP PDF p. 93 · EN PDF p. 104

JP main-only · printed p. 93 · EN main-only · printed p. 104

Quotient carrier types and canonical equivalence relations are fixed constructions from the input; variable order/chart/map fields are constrained by representative equations, not by assuming equality to the generated record. Other tuple fields are the explicit source definitions retained in the component inventory. HOL normalizes functions off their declared carriers solely to encode Lean's dependent-domain function equality; source uniqueness concerns those declared carriers. No uniqueness of a freely selected representational codomain is asserted.

2 mapped components
  1. chapter4-exact-uniqueness/canonical-order-local-global-uniqueness

    Representative invariance fixes canonical orders; their local and global incomparability relations fix quotient sets, projections and orders; chart commutation fixes transitions and local-to-global maps.

    The fixed domains and quotient objects are defined dependencies of the full bundle, not free output choices. HOL normalizes total-function values outside each source domain to undefined; this is an encoding of restricted maps, not an extra physical assumption. Lean uses domain subtypes. Uniqueness of the normalized representatives gives exactly uniqueness on the source domains.

lem:surjective-equality-kernel-factorization

JP PDF p. 94 · EN PDF p. 105

JP main-only · printed p. 94 · EN main-only · printed p. 105

Kernel inclusion is not strengthened to kernel equality. HOL uniqueness is restricted to Q because its functions are ambient total functions; Lean equality is extensional on the domain type Q. Empty source and quotient remain permitted.

2 mapped components
  1. chapter4-exact-uniqueness/surjection-and-kernel-premises

    Arbitrary sets S,Q,T, a surjection pi:S->Q, and Phi:S->T with EqKer(pi) subset EqKer(Phi).

    Lean uses function types and surjectivity. HOL uses image p A=Q and kernel implication restricted to A. Neither premise requires injectivity, an order on T, or a nonempty source.

    lean · CoreUniversalFactorization.lean · line 11
    isabelle · Core_Universal_Factorization.thy · line 16

  2. chapter4-exact-uniqueness/surjective-factor-exists-unique

    There exists a unique map barPhi:Q->T with Phi=barPhi composed with pi, defined by barPhi(pi(x))=Phi(x).

    Kernel inclusion gives well-definedness and surjectivity gives the whole domain and uniqueness. HOL uniqueness is pointwise on Q, exactly the source map domain; values outside Q are not claimed unique.

    lean · CoreUniversalFactorization.lean · line 11
    isabelle · Core_Universal_Factorization.thy · line 16

Proof-body and dependency correspondence
  • A fiber-invariant map along a surjection has a unique factor through the target of that surjection.
  • surjective_fiber_invariant_map_factors_uniquely chooses a preimage for each target point, proves factorization by kernel inclusion and proves uniqueness by surjectivity and function extensionality. HOL factor_choice_agrees and factor_agrees_on give the same construction on the declared carrier.
  • No injectivity, order or nonempty-domain assumption is added. Empty source is allowed; surjectivity then forces the quotient carrier to be empty.

thm:representation-uniqueness

JP PDF p. 96 · EN PDF p. 107

This theorem compares actual images, not entire chosen codomains. Lean's OrderIso on linear orders is equivalent to a bijection preserving and reflecting strict order; HOL explicitly states those facts and uniqueness on the first image. No normalization outside that image is a physical premise. The fixed-node omission of reception subscripts follows the explicit abbreviation declaration at the start of section04_03_00; varying role/family indices remain present.

    ExactOperable provides the source structures. Both equality-kernel and strict-order equivalences hold for each representation. The unique isomorphism is only between their images and commutes with the two maps.

    lean · CoreRepresentationImages.lean · line 78

  2. chapter4-universal-correspondence/local-representation-image-uniqueness

    For a fixed role R and phase u, instantiate S=U_R,u, same=local incomparability and strict=canonical strict order restricted to that domain.

  • Global representations and each fixed-phase local representation are unique up to the respective commuting strict order isomorphism of images.

cor:canonical-generation

JP PDF p. 102 · EN PDF p. 113

JP main-only · printed p. 102 · EN main-only · printed p. 113

The raw entry quantifies over realized configurations and typed comparison-rule data without assuming L1 or L2. Lean carries the specifications as a proof-indexed family over L1/L2; proof irrelevance makes the entered family independent of proof witnesses. Isabelle keeps the same raw configuration, restricts arrival domains to actual reception nodes, and interprets configuration_comparison only after obtaining L1/L2 from the full gate. Under an established prefix, each guarded condition reduces by guarded_step_iff to its active consequent. The full seventh-stage bundle is thus L1 and L2 together with the five residual conditions; guarded G remains an implication. Only the operative branch invokes the pre-existing output theorems. Native Output stores the varying realized loops, local projections and canonical relation; the input fixes the transport datum and specifications, while equivalence relations, quotient types and full projections are their canonical definitions. The eight-component gluing datum and three-component quotient are assembled from these fixed and generated components, not identified with the three Output fields alone. Empty carriers and failed L1/L2 cases are retained.

  • Under exact operability, every recursive component of the full EOSeq depends only on the three declared inputs and earlier generated components.

cor:no-primitive-time#proof

JP PDF p. 102 · EN PDF p. 113

JP main-only · printed p. 102 · EN main-only · printed p. 113

The conclusion is an input-dependency claim about EOSeq, not a claim that time does not exist. In the generic assembly, RoleOrder is instantiated by the concrete configuration-derived source order, so no independent primitive order is smuggled in. The full material and cumulative tuple component inventory is retained separately from the reduced formal output records. The source's explicit exact-operability conditions are hypotheses; they are not claimed to hold for every physical input.

    Use the entire comparison material, comparison quotient and representation bundles already mapped, not merely the five-field ordered output. Each fixed dependency comes from the declared three inputs or an earlier generated component. This conditional construction does not claim exact operability of arbitrary inputs.

cor:time-as-representation

JP PDF p. 103 · EN PDF p. 114

JP main-only · printed p. 103 · EN main-only · printed p. 114

ExactOperable supplies the canonical source/quotient and GlobalInc premise; it is not inferred from arbitrary numerical values. The target is an arbitrary linear order and the isomorphism is onto image(time), not onto all TimeVal. Lean subtype equality and HOL equality on explicit carrier sets express the same function identity.

1 mapped components
  1. chapter4-universal-correspondence/conventional-time-factorization

    For any conventional time map satisfying the equality and strict-order criteria, there is a unique strict-order isomorphism from the canonical global quotient to its image, and time factors through the canonical global projection.

    TimeVal is any supplied linear-order target, not necessarily the real line. The factor is defined onto Im(t), not all of TimeVal. The manuscript corollary is the global factor theorem specialized to the given t and its target order.

    lean · CoreExactCompletion.lean · line 134
    isabelle · Core_Exact_Completion.thy · line 198

Proof-body and dependency correspondence
  • Any supplied conventional time map satisfying both representation criteria factors uniquely through the canonical global order quotient onto its image.
  • conventional_time_factor instantiates quotient_factor_exists_unique and quotient_factor_commutes with the given time map and target order.
  • TimeVal may be any supplied linear-order target. The conclusion is not surjectivity onto all TimeVal and does not infer an arbitrary real representation without its hypotheses.

def:evaluation-predicate-extension

JP PDF p. 104 · EN PDF p. 115

JP main-only · printed p. 104 · EN main-only · printed p. 115

The rule is instantiated separately for each of eight conditions, with its actual predecessor-restricted D. Lean P accepts only a subtype witness in D, so no object can be evaluated outside its construction domain. HOL's ambient P is observed only under membership in D; any outside-domain extension of P is irrelevant to extended. The domain restriction to EvSpec exact and the predecessor tests remain input parameters and are not replaced by a single undifferentiated truth value.

  1. chapter5-dynamics-entry/bounded-predicate-extension

    For each of the eight dynamics conditions, D is the exact-evaluation subset satisfying that condition-specific predecessor list. K(Ev) iff there is the same evaluation e in D with P(e).

    The bounded witness preserves identity, rather than accepting some other successful evaluation. Truth is false outside D; quotient and map construction domains are not extended. Lean subtype P and HOL restricted P encode the same domain-qualified evaluation.

def:dynamics-CDB-relation

JP PDF p. 105 · EN PDF p. 116

JP main-only · printed p. 105 · EN main-only · printed p. 116

All raw carriers are fixed at the selected input and observer. R ranges over the existing three-element source-role type, with clock=C, detector=D and body=B. Dependent role-specific source and reception types in Lean correspond to role-indexed carrier subsets in HOL; HOL valid_reception expresses precisely those type constraints. The arrival images are derived from partial-arrival domains and values, not supplied independently. No recovery uniqueness, exact four-party descent, temporal order or completed dynamics condition is assumed. The local relation is a subset parameter; it is not forced to be the entire product or the image of the source relation at this definition.

JP PDF p. 125 · EN PDF p. 137

Lean Reindex(T,T) stores forward/inverse maps with both inverse laws and is exactly a self-bijection with its uniquely determined inverse. The faithful field is an arbitrary predicate on the dependent product over law indices, i.e. the source subset. It is not assumed to contain every self-bijection or to be nonempty, nor is law invariance inferred merely from membership: that is the subsequent K4 condition. HOL carrier_reindex is guarded on the corresponding actual evaluation tuple carrier, and typed_reindex_family imposes the componentwise carrier conditions. HOL faithful predicates are extensional with respect to equal component maps on those carriers; this represents the source self-bijections rather than adding an invariance requirement. The differential_spec root preserves the faithful component supplied by the already generated law family; it does not create or select its members.

TimeBases is instantiated with the time-base definition: its Point, domain and admitted fields are the specified carrier, D_e and Omega[e], and joint readiness retains every declared joint-specification condition. NumericDatum is the real-valued normal form forced by LawTimeDom subset rho[D_e]; it does not replace the unrestricted LawEvalDatSp. Its dependent Family retains every source candidate component and all five actual conditions. HOL uses the same declared time subset of real and typed index/value carrier sets; previously checked carrier encodings retain varying and empty carriers. Lean specification-dependent point carriers are represented in HOL by disjoint tagged point fibers, with domains confined to their own fiber and representations extended by zero off that fiber. Only restrictions to the declared domain occur in images, so this totalization adds no nonemptiness or common-physical-time premise. This correspondence is a reviewed mathematical encoding, not an automatic translation between assistants. The existential evaluation specification in the source is eliminated by its equality to the outer datum field. No readiness or admitted-representation conjunct is dropped. Existing order-embedding and generation results supply the meaning of admitted; this interface does not prove that arbitrary functions are physical time representations. The declared time,gen-to-gen abbreviation remains unchanged.

def:finite-tuple-concatenation

JP PDF p. 134 · EN PDF p. 145

JP main-only · printed p. 134 · EN main-only · printed p. 145

Lean Tuple is indexed by a list of component types, so its components need not have one homogeneous type. concatenate recursively preserves each component and its type, and split is indexed by the original type-list prefix. HOL uses an ordered list in a common tagged carrier and a position-indexed list of carrier subsets; typed_tuple_concat retains each component's carrier. For any finite family of source component types, their tagged disjoint union provides this common carrier without identifying different positions or values. The fixed-prefix-length premise of the HOL injectivity theorem is already fixed by the Lean type-list indices; it is not an extra mathematical restriction. This is tuple packaging and not an extra physical result. In the differential-stage seven-tuple, the order-quotient carrier itself is a component; choosing the type universe one level higher retains that component without flattening it into its elements.

1 mapped components
  1. chapter5-law-admissibility/finite-tuple-concatenation

    Concatenating finite tuples preserves each component in order, places all m first components before all n second components, and supports the displayed 3+2+2 flattening.

    Lean uses a type-indexed heterogeneous tuple. HOL list entries can be encoded in the disjoint union of the component carriers; typed_tuple preserves the index-specific carrier constraints. The fixed split lengths prevent ambiguous reconstruction; these containers add no new mathematical datum.

The source ordered seven-tuple maps to (OrderTime,embedding,representation,scalar,curves,candidate,faithful). OrderTime is the fixed generated type parameter, not a seventh mutable field in DifferentialData; the other six fields occur in precisely the source order. Reattaching that type yields the full source tuple, so the six record fields do not remove a source component. The curve family J and its generated value ranges instantiate ObsIdx_quot and its own value types; the raw V-valued record is accompanied by differential_curve_typed. The common candidate family contains the same original candidate relations, domains and input/output curve values, and faithful is the source subset predicate. Lean source-domain types correspond to HOL guarded carriers and extensional restrictions; HOL equality outside the source carrier is normalized by restrict, not made a new physical equation. LawTimeAdm is instantiated by the existing five law conditions, retained by differential_with_law_conditions. This source definition supplies no derivative operators or additional differentiability assumptions; those belong to the next evaluation-structure definition.

def:differential-evaluation-structure

JP PDF p. 135 · EN PDF p. 146

JP main-only · printed p. 135 · EN main-only · printed p. 146

At a fixed representation, RawFamily.selected, order/orderPositive, dim, timeIndex/valIndex, their Nonempty fields, time/valChart, timeOpen/valueOpen and cover give all source fields. Family.relation supplies the arbitrary local relation. Candidate changes are uniquely derived from those retained charts by chartChange; the stored tuple therefore recovers their entire pair-indexed families without an extra independent choice. The Lean time and value source subsets live inside the actual EvalAt and SideValue types, while HOL uses guarded source carriers. Neither chart type asserts a homeomorphism, Ck regularity or compatibility at this definition stage. Those later conditions are separate predicates and are not hypotheses of this contract. Fin2 dependent joint coordinates correspond to the ordered input/output product; its canonical coordinate concatenation has dimension m_in+m_out, with both zero-dimensional cases retained. The existing finite-coordinate flattening and norm-transport support supplies this carrier identification; no generic infinite-dimensional norm equivalence is asserted. Domain k V is exactly a Fin(k+1) vector whose zeroth component lies in V; its remaining1..k components are unrestricted. HOL jet_domain uses the same finite restriction. Smoothness assumptions in generated-jet lemmas apply to the later realized jets, not to this carrier or to arbitrary JetRel. HOL handles each selected component at its own coordinate types/order; its family assembly and nonempty time-index fibre transport do not impose equal dimensions or equal index sets across components. At a single representation no extension to an all-representation family is claimed merely from this definition. Its fields are the fixed-representation portion of the already checked family structure. Nonempty index carriers do not imply nonempty individual chart domains; empty overlaps are allowed. No additional hypothesis and no source or figure change. The cardinality boundary unit derives the stated prose obstruction from the open real-image and coverage fields. It even allows arbitrary maps rather than requiring injective charts, so its contradiction applies to the source bijections without adding a premise. H is the individual evaluation-time domain, not the whole source family. Chart indices are unrestricted. The real-indexed Nat-source example shows why countability of individual sources does not establish countability of their tagged union. Both systems retain the empty-domain control; no physical premise is added.

    For every ordered pair of time charts or product value charts, the change candidate is the target chart composed with the inverse source chart, defined only on the source-coordinate image of the common source-domain overlap. The two candidate sets contain exactly these pair-indexed maps.

def:typed-failure-refinement-forest

JP PDF p. 182 · EN PDF p. 196

JP main-only · printed p. 182 · EN main-only · printed p. 196

Lean encodes a path by a root label paired with a finite child-label list; HOL uses the same representation with an explicit root set I. Child labels use a common ambient carrier L while admissibility is the path-dependent set J(p); heterogeneous source index types may be injected with tags into this carrier, preserving path ownership and without identifying distinct labels. The source construction concerns sets of child labels, not an imposed uniform child subset. Lean PathNode is the subtype of the union of valid levels; HOL masks children outside the valid node set to empty and source correspondence is restricted to valid nodes. Off-node values of the total HOL region function are unused. No finite branching, nonempty root, nonempty child set, depth cap, complete coverage or sibling-disjointness premise is introduced. Child containment is exactly the source premise. Depth-tag erasure is both injective and onto the truncated path set. The generic forest's ancestor relation is instantiated on this actual path carrier, not on the previous two-level example.

def:dynamics-stage-condition-group

JP PDF p. 211 · EN PDF p. 226

JP main-only · printed p. 211 · EN main-only · printed p. 226

At each fixed complete Ev, the eight Conditions fields are instantiated with the source's eight extended native predicates, whose individual definitions and native domains already have separate bilingual contracts listed here. This bridge verifies their order, conjunction and formation/readiness wiring; it does not replace their mathematical definitions by unconstrained Boolean values or re-prove their native content. Source indices1..8 map to Lean Fin8 values0..7 and HOL naturals0..7. HOL indexed is used only under i<8, so its unconstrained out-of-range list values are irrelevant. EvSpecExact is the exactInput predicate at this Ev. formExact is exactly the source's input constraint, not a new hypothesis introduced to shorten a proof. Ready is the existing token-graph readiness predicate, and Recurs is the source's already constructed state recursion. No InputSat, all-ancestor-true, real-embedding existence, or total-trajectory hypothesis is added. The correspondence uses the existing subtype-aware extension theorem independently for each native domain; off-domain falsity is not identified with failure.

TimeBases is instantiated with the time-base definition: its Point, domain and admitted fields are the specified carrier, D_e and Omega[e], and joint readiness retains every declared joint-specification condition. NumericDatum is the real-valued normal form forced by LawTimeDom subset rho[D_e]; it does not replace the unrestricted LawEvalDatSp. Its dependent Family retains every source candidate component and all five actual conditions. HOL uses the same declared time subset of real and typed index/value carrier sets; previously checked carrier encodings retain varying and empty carriers. Lean specification-dependent point carriers are represented in HOL by disjoint tagged point fibers, with domains confined to their own fiber and representations extended by zero off that fiber. Only restrictions to the declared domain occur in images, so this totalization adds no nonemptiness or common-physical-time premise. This correspondence is a reviewed mathematical encoding, not an automatic translation between assistants. GeneratedSelection stores the chosen datum and its reference representation in the same selected component. compatible is precisely the source required generation membership, not an extra assumption for a proof search. Domain inclusion follows from this and same_spec. The choice is supplied, not produced canonically. forget passes this exact datum to the already checked varying-carrier failure interface. The native single-object construction and the meaning of the time-base fields retain their separate source dependencies; this interface does not assert automatic construction of a selected family. Formation is selected membership and evaluation input is true. All source abbreviations and dependence on the selection are retained.

prop:law-bearing-level-failure-condition

JP PDF p. 216 · EN PDF p. 231

JP main-only · printed p. 216 · EN main-only · printed p. 231

The selected source family supplies a base representation and a generated datum together. CoreSelectedGeneratedLaw retains all three generated-membership clauses and derives readiness on the selected single tag. Its forget map preserves the exact datum passed to the varying-carrier five-condition and failure predicates. The source selected subset remains a subset, not the whole DynOperative locus; no converse domain inclusion or automatic selection is introduced. The theorem holds for every typed generated pair and therefore for the manuscript native single-object pairs. The native construction and time-base meaning are checked by their separate dependency contracts, not inferred from this failure equivalence. The Japanese prose and English displayed proof equivalence remain one semantic assertion. The numerical carrier and HOL tagged-carrier encoding are detailed in the three corresponding definition contracts.

    Domain readiness and same_spec supply the identification. The Japanese proof states the biconditional in prose between two inline expressions; English writes one display with those exact two operands. The displayed connective and the Japanese equivalence sentence are pinned together, not counted as missing mathematics.

The formal Regions family uses second-child type Empty (HOL empty set), so only roots and first-level children occur; it is the explicit depth-one instance of the source path-indexed forest. Different parent regions may overlap. Distinct pure children of one parent are disjoint, but the source definition does not assert that every parent is covered by its pure children; the unrefined region remains. Both labels in this physical source block are aliases of one definition.

prop:differential-failure-witnesses

JP PDF p. 226 · EN PDF p. 242

JP main-only · printed p. 226 · EN main-only · printed p. 242

The source's selected differential family is the single-object specialization, so Omega[e] is the observer's real time-order-embedding set used in the witness formula. Lean's native predicates carry proofs of their defining domain; HOL uses conjunctions with those domain predicates, and negation yields guarded counterexamples. Neither implementation drops those guards or changes unary/binary arity. The theorem is quantifier duality for the concrete predicate family; it does not assert existence of a counterexample unless the condition fails.

    Negating universal quantification gives existential quantification of the same arity. Lean negates existential proof-dependent jet/atlas witnesses into forall-proofs negation; HOL uses the equivalent implication negation. Under minimality the ancestor bundle supplies those prerequisites. Empty representation domains yield no witness rather than an invented representative.

The quantitative equality retains the pointwise equivalence between approximation completion and nine defect/tolerance inequalities.     The assembled outputs are unique. Full validity is the intersection of strict and approximation validity. JP main-only · printed p. 244 · EN main-only · printed p. 262

This complete definition contract supplements the already recorded exact component correspondences for its six displays. It preserves the distinction between audit validity values and undefined-reason values; the full report retains the datum rather than only its evaluated states. The signature is the Boolean function on the disjoint union of the six index sets.

3 mapped components
  1. chapter6-operational-readout/four-diagnostics-and-three-part-report

    Four diagnostic fields are tagged failed positions, failure signature, boundary data and burden pair. Boundary uses approximation-local reasons; the other three use global reasons. The full report retains data, five-field state report and four-field diagnostic report.

    The native audit-fail fiber equals the internal failed fiber under the recursive evaluation, so the diagnostic payload is the source failed set. Boundary value and roots are the previously generated localization inputs; generic report types do not assert they are independently produced.

prop:audit-determines-stage-status

JP PDF p. 246 · EN PDF p. 264

JP main-only · printed p. 246 · EN main-only · printed p. 264

The formal finite run is a 40-step rank-bounded implementation of the same 38-token recursive equations, not an additional assumption about source evaluation order. Any topological evaluation solves those equations, whose uniqueness yields order independence. Fin 6 indexes the named six series; priorities exactly encode Pass < Indeterminate < Unformed < Blocked < Fail.

1 mapped components
  1. chapter6-operational-readout/deterministic-status-group-reason

    For the declared recursive state, each token has one audit status, each series has a unique priority maximum, and local/global reason sets are determined independently of a chosen linear extension.

    Pass iff internal sat relies on the coherence of the recursive state and predecessor Boolean. It is not a theorem for arbitrary unrelated p and s. The finite runner supplies the same unique state as the native recursion.

prop:audit-representation-invariance

JP PDF p. 247 · EN PDF p. 266

JP main-only · printed p. 247 · EN main-only · printed p. 266

Uniqueness is of the induced map with the prescribed component actions, not uniqueness among all set bijections. Lean reportEquiv constructs both inverse laws; Isabelle Core_Report_Equivalences, imported by Core_Typed_Report_Covariance, explicitly proves report_map_left_inverse, report_map_right_inverse and report_map_bijective. The source assumes boundary preservation; the quantitative scale transport additionally derives it from ordered defect data where applicable, without requiring that supplementary specialization for every report.

2 mapped components
  1. chapter6-operational-transport/bijective-induced-commuting-report

    The induced full report map is a bijection, commutes with typed readout at corresponding scales, and is unique among maps with the prescribed action on every report component.

    Uniqueness is not among arbitrary bijections that happen to map one report to another. The data, state and diagnostic component actions are fixed by the input isomorphism. All five transformed certificate fields are retained.

def:closed-interval-audit-kernel

JP PDF p. 252 · EN PDF p. 271

JP main-only · printed p. 252 · EN main-only · printed p. 271

Intervals are stored by ordered endpoint pairs; the represented closed interval is [lower,upper] in the ambient linear order. Endpoint membership in S does not assert S is convex. The branch proofs hold for an arbitrary linear order and are instantiated with nonnegative extended reals. Lean Interval carries lower<=upper in its type; the HOL fail equivalence has this same guard explicitly. HOL ereal includes negative values, but the source instantiation restricts endpoints and threshold to the nonnegative carrier; the generic order results are stronger, not restricted to finite reals. The output uses the existing shared five-valued AuditStatus type, while this particular kernel returns only its three stated values.

    Lean stores endpoint ordering in Interval; HOL interval_fail explicitly assumes it. Generic linear-order lemmas specialize to ENNReal or nonnegative ereal. Equality at the upper endpoint and an infinite threshold pass.

def:observer-communication-datum

JP PDF p. 254 · EN PDF p. 273

JP main-only · printed p. 254 · EN main-only · printed p. 273

The graph's V type is the declared O physical-carrier type, E is the edge carrier, and its actual vertices/edges are finite subsets. Total source/target/carrier/metric functions in the ambient encoding are read only on actual edges; the source context supplies an actual edge through its required positive-length link, so arbitrary extensions outside the edge subset add no source obligation. Lean Walk stores n>0 and Fin n -> E with membership/adjacency proofs. HOL stores n and nat -> E guarded by walk, reads indices below n only, and words_typed requires word maps to ignore values outside this active prefix and to be None on invalid walks. This is the finite-tuple representation condition, not an added communication assumption. Source finite tuples have unique active-prefix contents. WC/WD are instantiated with the already defined role-specific ExtWord types. Lean Option functions and guarded HOL option functions encode the original partial maps, without new totality, walk-reversal, transitivity, or edge-type/word-action compatibility assumptions. The Lean graph and interval records carry conditions that are explicit graph_typed/metric_typed guards in HOL. HOL ereal is restricted to nonnegative endpoints; probability endpoints use real[0,1]. Data stores the graph by its parameter and the physical-carrier, edge-kind, word and six metric maps as fields; walks and closed walks are reconstructed from that graph, so the displayed source tuple can be recovered exactly. Both input evaluations and the common scale are retained in communicationContext. This definition supplies measured intervals; it does not derive empirical measurements from graph topology.

def:engineering-nonmonotone-boundary-data

JP PDF p. 259 · EN PDF p. 278

JP main-only · printed p. 259 · EN main-only · printed p. 278

Fix r and instantiate D=Lambda_r. The total ambient defect function is read only on D, hence represents the original domain-restricted map without adding data outside that domain. Both backends use native nonnegative extended reals, including infinity; envelope uses the identical image-set supremum. The source asks for envelope values only on D, where reflexivity ensures a nonempty supremum index. No defect monotonicity premise is used for envelope monotonicity. Lean Monotone is valid for preorders; Isabelle's standard mono abbreviation has a stronger library type class, so the HOL root states the equivalent universal x<=y implication directly and retains preorder, rather than adding antisymmetry. PartitionData stores the actual finite active-index set, exact cover, disjointness, convexity and per-region monotonicity. HOL partition_typed carries the same record conditions explicitly. Empty domains and empty regions are not prohibited by either encoding. The permission predicates represent the two explicitly stated data-dependent permissions and the stated no-data fallback; they do not infer that supplied data exist merely because a numerical envelope can be defined, do not resolve the case of two available methods by priority, and assert no uniqueness of the selected method in that case. The source reference and nonmonotone flag are fixed parameters, not erased from the surrounding engineering evidence.

3 mapped components
  1. chapter6-engineering-effects/finite-convex-monotone-partition

    The active index set is finite; its pairwise-disjoint regions cover exactly the reference scale domain. Each region is order-convex and the restricted defect map is monotone.

    No global monotonicity or finite scale domain is inferred. HOL explicit partition_typed fields match the dependent Lean record. Empty regions are not forbidden by the source.

def:record-configuration-engineering-structural-burden

JP PDF p. 264 · EN PDF p. 284

JP main-only · printed p. 264 · EN main-only · printed p. 284

The source fixes two operative contexts and then applies these set constructions. Instantiate each generic Configuration separately with its own reference/evidence carriers, verified family, refs, tag, state and target maps; the theorem configuration_delta expressly permits distinct R0/E0 and R1/E1. Tokens and the kernel output carrier alone are shared. Pair, distributed-pair, bulk/following and physical realization hypotheses remain the source context already recorded in the engineering/communication data interfaces; the set identities proved here hold for all typed configurations, hence also for that stated context, without dropping a condition from a source implication. Source target indices1,2 map to Fin2 indices0,1, while configuration indices0,1 retain their original meaning. HOL target quantifiers are guarded k<2. The source's partial predicates/state restriction are represented by total extensions read only after verified/selected membership, never on out-of-domain evidence. The indexed evidence set is pairs(k,e); the failing union removes the target tag as the source explicitly does before EngTarget image. The ordinary union does not assume target evidence disjointness. The prior CoreRecordBurden9-tag carrier is not reused as the full13-tag input interface; its earlier restricted results remain immutable, and this unit supplies the complete tag-selection definition.

  1. chapter6-engineering-burden/burden-and-symmetric-difference

    Each burden applies the same structural kernel to that configuration failure-token set; bulk/follow are its two instances and triangle is their symmetric difference.

    The generic13-tag construction fixes the full source domain. The equality/symmetric-difference identity holds for arbitrary sets and therefore does not require restricting the whole engineering universe to the older nine-tag subtype.

JP PDF p. 265 · EN PDF p. 286

The source permits configuration-specific reference, value and evidence types. The new generic kernel roots quantify only over the two resulting subsets of the common failure-token carrier and the common target map; they therefore impose no common engineering-input type.     Burden equality is equivalent to empty symmetric difference. A token in one configuration whose singleton burden is not contained in the other gives a nonempty one-sided difference. Witnesses in both directions give inclusion-incomparability.

    The proof is the generic singleton-kernel separation lemma applied to the13-tag-filtered token sets. Neither different tags nor different carrier configurations alone proves separation. Both witness premises remain present; no unconditional ordering of bulk and following burdens is asserted.

fig:recursive-common-input-composition

Recursive assembly of the existing role, raw-input, configuration and common-input definitions

  1. A local scene carries the four role components and their binding witness. — semantic:def:role-instance
  2. The object-specification index identifies the bundle of its four role instances. — semantic:def:role-instance
  3. Restrict the role-instance bundle family to the declared object-index set. — semantic:def:role-instance-family
  4. Combine that family with physical carriers, realization maps, body abstraction sources and the reception network. — semantic:def:raw-operational-input
  5. Pair the raw operational input with the source datum. — semantic:def:realized-operational-configuration
  6. Pair the realized operational configuration with the typed comparison-rule family. — semantic:def:comparison-rule-dependent-common-input
